convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'GG-RSI-CCI' custom indicator with multiple smoothing parameters. Depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Custom indicator signal interpretation (0/1/2 values) requires understanding the external indicator's buffer layout.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for trade signal timing

other_exits: MODE_FLAT: when indicator signal=1 (neutral), both long and short positions are closed
MODE_TREND: signal=1 (neutral) does not trigger any closes; positions only closed on opposite trend signal (2 closes short, 0 closes long)
Long close triggered when indicator value=0 (sell signal) and BuyPosClose permission is true
Short close triggered when indicator value=2 (buy signal) and SellPosClose permission is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values are interpreted as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots), positive values are interpreted as deposit share fraction. Logic handled in TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: The GG-RSI-CCI indicator outputs discrete signal values on buffer 1: 0=sell, 1=neutral, 2=buy. Entry uses SignalBar=1 (previous bar) comparing value[1] (current signal bar) vs value[0] (one bar older) to detect signal transitions. If SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated on every tick without new-bar guard. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are set to last bar datetime + timeframe duration, passed to trade functions for signal validation. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen with internal position checks and possibly time-based signal expiry. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean permission gates for each trade direction and action.
python_conversion_notes: The GG-RSI-CCI custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python or its signal values pre-computed and fed as a data series. The indicator combines RSI and CCI with dual-smoothing (Period1 rough, Period2 fine) using configurable smoothing methods (SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA). The JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA methods from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh are non-standard and require porting. Signal interpretation is discrete (0=short, 1=neutral, 2=long) from buffer index 1. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) handle position management, lot sizing logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), and signal-time validation - all must be reimplemented. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so point-to-price conversion depends on symbol digits. Deviation parameter (10 points) is for slippage control.
